content.comment_body: Hello, I plan to use [product_name] to interface with [product_name] and I'm unsure which version to purchase for my device, which is FS4. My aim is to display data on a PC screen, create graphical representations of I/O status, and show statistics. Thank you.

The current version for the [product_name] software suite is recommended. The choice depends on which panel type you use. For a basic panel, the basic version will be enough. If you use a comfort panel, you need at least the comfort or advanced version.

Thank you for your reply. I have another question: if I purchase the comfort or advanced version, can I also access the features of the basic version, or are comfort and advanced editions completely separate software? Where can I find more details about the types of [product_name] and their specifications? Thank you.

Check this resource: It explains which functions are available in each [product_name] engineering version (Basic/Comfort/Advanced/Professional), and also outlines the feature differences between the various panel types.
So if I get the professional version, I'll be able to configure all device types such as panels, SCADA, etc. Is that correct? Thank you.
Yes, that's correct. The professional version covers all devices, but it's also the priciest option.
